mentions.name: Bilembi
mentions.description: An iPhone app that runs iOS-native AI agents using both cloud and local models, powered by llama.cpp. It exposes basic iOS tools such as calendar and reminders, plus advanced tools including a custom QuickJS JavaScript environment with modules like an HTTP client and Git. The app features a llama.cpp wrapper with prompt caching/forking and automatic model loading/unloading based on device memory constraints, and agent execution modes designed to make reasoning about agent security and prompt injection attacks easier. It is available on TestFlight.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an iPhone app to run iOS-native agents using both cloud and local models, powered by llama.cpp. It has access basic iOS tools such as calendar, reminders etc. but also more advanced ones like a custom JS environment running on QuickJS that can use various custom modules like an HTTP client, Git etc.
